newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open 0.05 cent higher.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open 0.05 cent higher.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open 0.05 cent firmer Monday, dealers said, with benchmark October expected to stage a run for the contract highs reached Friday.
A move over 11.70 cents a lb in October, they said, could trigger buy stops and send the contract to new highs. But producers are likely to provide resistance at each point up.

Friday, October settled 0.07 cent higher at 11.63 cents after trading from a new contract high of 11.70 cents to 11.55 cents. March finished up 0.11 at 11.90 cents, just under the lifetime high of 11.91 reached ahead of the close. The rest ended 0.11 to 0.15 cent firmer.

LIFFE white sugar futures were firmer Monday after steady commission house buying lifted spot October to a new lifetime high of $331.00 early. At 0843 EDT/1243 GMT, October stood $1.30 firmer at $330.00.
